data.gender_notes: Mirdad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mirdad is derived from the Arabic word 'Nur' which means light. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes one who enlightens others. The name Mirdad carries the meaning “Light Giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mirdad usually hope their child will grow to embody light giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
